hci: Handle both Command Complete and Command Status for simple commands On buddy (using Wilkins Peak), the controller returns the error Vendor command with Command Status instead of Command Complete, but still returns Command Complete for non-error case. Therefore, we have to handle both Command Complete and Command Status. hciCmdSubmitSimpleWithCompleteAndStatusSync is added to the internal helper API to do that. Side change: This CL fixes the handling of multi-advertising feature detection. If no multi-adv feature support is detected, instead of bringing down the stack, NewBlue should fallback to the single-adv support. BUG=chromium:979922 TEST=Manual test newblue initialization on buddy Change-Id: I3eb9ce567b1ec9ee8e5edd35f425d4dadfa2f9d1 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1683887 Tested-by: Sonny Sasaka <sonnysasaka@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Miao-chen Chou <mcchou@chromium.org>

flash_chip: read the debugfs node for flashinfo Currently, we use the command 'flashrom -p host/ec --flash-name' to get the flashinfo. However, the vendor/name data reports from the flashrom isn't consistent to the underlying flashinfo on some platforms. To fix this problem, we submit a patch to upstream linux kernel https://patchwork.ozlabs.org/patch/1109228/ to output the flashinfo to the debugfs node. This patch adds a check and query the partname/partid if needed.
